sections.title: Force Gems
sections.note: 20 gems for passengers and cargo, each listed under the realm where it's handed over. Carben's and Noko's are required. Anjean's extra gem is in the Main Quest.

items.name: Carben
items.area: Papuchia Village to the Ocean Sanctuary
items.howTo: Bring Carben down from the birds in Papuchia Village with the Song of Birds and drive him to the Ocean Sanctuary, fighting off the Miniblins and Big Blin who board the train.
items.reward: Tracks south of the Trading Post: Warp Gate B and a Grass Rabbit
items.notes: Required (Main Quest: Duet with Carben). Prima no. 1 (Zelda Wiki), Zelda Dungeon no. 1, IGN no. 1.

items.name: Orca's husband
items.howTo: Orca, in the middle house of Papuchia Village, wants a bearded, big-nosed, burly husband. Fetch Dovok, the chief of Whittleton, from his hut at the north of the village and drive him to her.
items.reward: Tracks east of Whittleton: two Grass Rabbits
items.notes: Prima no. 2 (Zelda Wiki), Zelda Dungeon no. 2, IGN no. 2. Wadatsumi, rescued later from the Pirate Hideout, was her sweetheart.

items.name: Mona
items.howTo: Mona, in the house on the west side of Castle Town, misses her rabbit-mad husband. Take her to Bunnio at Rabbitland Rescue, then talk to her again by the train when she's calmed down.
items.reward: Tracks west of the Forest Sanctuary: two Grass Rabbits
items.notes: Prima no. 3 (Zelda Wiki), Zelda Dungeon no. 3, IGN no. 5.

items.name: Joe
items.area: Aboda Village to Beedle's Air Shop
items.howTo: Joe, the boy by Aboda Village's station, wants to see the world from the sky. Find Beedle's balloon on the map, whistle to land it and stop at the Air Shop with Joe aboard.
items.reward: A shortcut west of Castle Town
items.notes: Prima no. 4 (Zelda Wiki), Zelda Dungeon no. 4, IGN no. 6. Zelda Wiki says the shortcut runs between Castle Town and the Forest Temple.

items.name: Noko
items.howTo: Noko, by the water at the west end of Anouki Village, can't make Mega Ice in the ChuChu-tainted water. Drive him to the lake at Wellspring Station.
items.reward: Tracks east of Anouki Village: Warp Gate C and a link to the Forest Realm
items.notes: Required: he sells the Mega Ice that cools Goron Village. Possible once Carben's duet is done (Zelda Wiki); Zelda Dungeon does it when Kagoron asks for ice. Prima no. 5 (Zelda Wiki), Zelda Dungeon no. 5, IGN no. 8.

items.name: Goron's lava-blocked house
items.howTo: Buy Mega Ice from Noko at Wellspring Station and reach Goron Village with at least 10 units left. Give it to the Goron at the east end of the village, whose house is still cut off by lava.
items.reward: Tracks south of the Goron Target Range: Warp Gate F, Desert Rabbit and a link to the Ocean Realm through the Sand Realm
items.notes: Ice melts outside the Snow Realm, so hurry. Zelda Dungeon calls the warp gate D. Prima no. 8 (Zelda Wiki), Zelda Dungeon no. 6, IGN no. 16.

items.name: Lucia's fish
items.howTo: Buy a load of fish (20 for 50 Rupees) from Niboshi in Papuchia Village and reach Castle Town with at least 10. Give them to Lucia, the fish-mad woman by the fountain in the middle of town.
items.reward: Tracks south of the Tower of Spirits into the Ocean Realm: a Grass Rabbit and an Ocean Rabbit
items.notes: Fish spoil and Snurgles go for them. Doing Niboshi's Mega Ice first keeps them fresher (IGN). Prima no. 12 (Zelda Wiki), Zelda Dungeon no. 7, IGN no. 3.

items.name: Harry's Cuccos
items.howTo: Buy five Cuccos for 50 Rupees from the Cucco man in north-west Castle Town and take them to Harry at the pen in north-west Aboda Village. He wants 10, so make a second trip.
items.reward: Tracks north of Aboda Village: Warp Gate E to the Fire Realm
items.notes: Any hit can lose a Cucco. Prima no. 13 (Zelda Wiki), Zelda Dungeon no. 8, IGN no. 4.

items.name: Mash's Goron Iron
items.howTo: Buy Goron Iron from the Goron in west Goron Village (by the mailbox) and reach Whittleton with at least 5 units. Give it to Mash, the lumberjack west of the station, for new axes.
items.reward: A shortcut west of the Forest Temple to Warp Gate A
items.notes: Prima no. 9 (Zelda Wiki), Zelda Dungeon no. 9, IGN no. 7.

items.name: Yeko's fence
items.area: Whittleton and the Trading Post to Anouki Village
items.howTo: Yeko in Anouki Village needs lumber and a builder. Buy lumber in Whittleton (100 Rupees), pick up Kenzo where he still stands at the Trading Post bridge, and reach Anouki Village with at least 15 logs and Kenzo aboard.
items.reward: Tracks in the north-west of the Snow Realm: Snowdrift Station and a Snow Rabbit
items.notes: Yeko also gives a Treasure for bringing Kenzo. Prima no. 10 (Zelda Wiki), Zelda Dungeon no. 10, IGN no. 11.

items.name: Ferrus meets Alfonzo
items.area: Snow Realm tracks to Aboda Village
items.howTo: A letter from Ferrus shows him in the snow. Find him beside the north-south tracks just south-east of the Snow Temple (listen for his camera), and drive him to Alfonzo's house in Aboda Village.
items.reward: A shortcut from Castle Town to the Bridge Worker's Home
items.notes: Prima no. 11 (Zelda Wiki), Zelda Dungeon no. 11, IGN no. 19.

items.name: Steem's vessel
items.area: Papuchia Village to the Snow Sanctuary
items.howTo: Have the Wise One in Papuchia Village's largest house tell your fortune, say your luck is bad, and buy her Vessel for 50 Rupees. Take it to Steem at the Snow Sanctuary without the train taking a single hit.
items.reward: Tracks in the north of the Snow Realm: Slippery Station
items.notes: If you're hit, let the enemies win so you restart with the Vessel intact (IGN). Prima no. 14 (Zelda Wiki), Zelda Dungeon no. 12, IGN no. 10.

items.name: Goron visits Anouki Village
items.howTo: Talk to the Goron near Goron Village's station who wants to see snow and drive him to Anouki Village.
items.reward: Tracks north-west of Wellspring Station: Warp Gate D and two Snow Rabbits
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon calls the warp gate F. Prima no. 6 (Zelda Wiki), Zelda Dungeon no. 13, IGN no. 9.

items.name: Kofu visits Goron Village
items.howTo: Kofu, in Honcho's house in Anouki Village, wants to see Goron Village. Drive him there.
items.reward: A link north between the Snow and Fire Realms
items.notes: Prima no. 7 (Zelda Wiki), Zelda Dungeon no. 14, IGN no. 12.

items.name: Goron child in Castle Town
items.howTo: The Goron Elder's grandson, outside the Elder's house, dreams of the big city and Princess Zelda. Drive him to Castle Town and keep talking to him as he explores.
items.reward: Tracks in the north-west of the Fire Realm: Disorientation Station and a Mountain Rabbit
items.notes: Prima no. 15 (Zelda Wiki), Zelda Dungeon no. 15, IGN no. 17.

items.name: Niboshi's Mega Ice
items.howTo: Niboshi, the fish seller in Papuchia Village, needs ice for her fish. Buy Mega Ice at Wellspring Station and reach her with at least 10 units, using Warp Gate B to save time.
items.reward: Tracks north of Papuchia Village: the Pirate Hideout
items.notes: Prima no. 16 (Zelda Wiki), Zelda Dungeon no. 16, IGN no. 14.

items.name: Wadatsumi
items.howTo: In the Pirate Hideout's north cave, shoot the Miniblins and the Big Blin to free Wadatsumi, then drive him to Papuchia Village, fighting off the pirate ships and the boarders.
items.reward: Tracks in the middle of the Ocean Realm: Warp Gate G, an Ocean Rabbit and shortcuts
items.notes: The Pirate Hideout minigame can then be replayed for the Quiver and a Heart Container. Prima no. 17 (Zelda Wiki), Zelda Dungeon no. 17, IGN no. 13.

items.name: Rael's Cuccos
items.area: Castle Town to the Sand Sanctuary
items.howTo: Rael wants Cuccos to study. Buy five from the Cucco man in Castle Town and deliver all five to the Sand Sanctuary.
items.reward: Tracks in the north-east of the Fire Realm: Ends of the Earth Station and a Mountain Rabbit
items.notes: Zelda Wiki says it's possible once you have the Sand Wand. The Cuccos also reach the Sand Sanctuary's stamp. Prima no. 20 (Zelda Wiki), Zelda Dungeon no. 18, IGN no. 20.

items.name: Ferrus on the Ocean Floor
items.area: Fire Realm tracks to the Ocean Temple
items.howTo: After the Sand Temple, enter the Tower of Spirits; Ferrus's next letter shows him on the tracks north of the Goron Target Range. Pick him up and take him to the Ocean Temple on the Ocean Floor, using Warp Gate F east of the tower (Zelda Dungeon calls it D).
items.reward: Tracks in the east of the Fire Realm: the Dark Ore Mine and a link to the Sand Realm
items.notes: A third letter later puts him north of the Forest Sanctuary, south of the Forest Temple, with a Treasure for you. Prima no. 18 (Zelda Wiki), Zelda Dungeon no. 19, IGN no. 18.

items.name: Linebeck's Dark Ore
items.area: Dark Ore Mine to the Trading Post
items.howTo: First beat the Rocktite in the cave east of the Dark Ore Mine. Buy Dark Ore (10 for 200 Rupees) in the mine's middle cavern, get through that cave with at least 9 units, then take Warp Gates H and G and reach Linebeck III at the Trading Post with at least 5.
items.reward: Tracks in the south-east of the Ocean Realm: the Lost at Sea Station and an Ocean Rabbit
items.notes: Sunlight ruins the ore. Further loads give a Treasure (Zelda Dungeon) or Rupees (IGN). Prima no. 19 (Zelda Wiki), Zelda Dungeon no. 20, IGN no. 15.
